response.scene_summary: The clip begins with a blank screen before loading a 'Card Condition Vault' application. A Pokémon card (Tauros) is displayed on the left, while a 'LIVE CHECKLIST' on the right shows real-time progress of various image analysis steps. The checklist items progressively update from 'WAITING'/'CHECKING' to 'DONE' as the card is processed.
key_observations: The UI loads and displays a Pokémon card for analysis.

A 'LIVE CHECKLIST' tracks the progress of image processing steps like 'Card detected', 'Edges visible', 'Blur check', 'Glare check', 'Perspective normalized', 'Front recognized', and 'Corner regions extracted'.
The 'Corner regions extracted' step visually highlights different parts of the card (top-left, bottom-right, top edge, bottom edge) as it processes.
All checklist items successfully complete and show 'DONE' by the end of the clip.
